recipe.calibration: Set12 01.png, sigma of the network, test_noise seed 0, host emulation
recipe.window_generator: one np.random.default_rng(42) per network, layer order (the windows of perms.json, checked)
recipe.objective: mean W=4 window cycles, max(ceil(K/4)+1, ceil(COUT/16)*max(1, max_b nnz_b), COUT), under the skewed bank rule
recipe.search: bankperm/fit.py fit_general: identity start, 400 swaps of channels in different classes, accept if the objective falls by > 1e-10, seed 42 + fitted-layer index
recipe.bank_of_tap: (s + class) % 4, class = p % 4 of the channel's position p; the layout puts channel order[p] of 3x3 position s in slot s*C + (p + s) % C (C % 4 == 0); for C % 4 == 1 the conventional slot s*C + p (its bank is already (s + p) % 4)
recipe.order: position -> original channel; class of position p is p % 4 (fit.order_from_group)
